Container.Name: iOpenWRT
Container.Overview: Web-based controller and monitor for OpenWrt routers. Manage and monitor your network devices over SSH/ubus from a single dashboard. Includes device discovery, status monitoring, and a built-in SQLite database for persistence. After install, browse to the WebUI and sign in with the username/password you set below.
Container.Description:
Web-based controller and monitor for OpenWrt routers. Manage and monitor your network devices over SSH/ubus from a single dashboard.
After the container starts, open the WebUI and sign in with the credentials you set below. All data (device list, settings, users) is persisted in the mapped /app/data SQLite database.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the iOpenWRT web interface listens on inside the container. Most users should leave this at 8780 and only change the host-side port mapping if 8780 is taken on the host.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (device list, users, settings). Do NOT delete this on update or you will lose your configuration.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Initial admin username for the iOpenWRT web UI. Used only on first run to seed the user; later changes should be done in the UI.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Initial admin password for the iOpenWRT web UI. CHANGE THIS before exposing the container.

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Port the Node.js server inside the container binds to. Must match the WebUI Port above. Advanced users only.
